name: Child Discipline
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of timely and loving discipline in the upbringing of children, highlighting that withholding correction is detrimental to their well-being and growth. Proverbs teaches that the rod of correction, when applied with love, drives foolishness from a child's heart and imparts wisdom, ensuring they are trained in the right way and will not depart from it in adulthood. The discipline of a child is portrayed not as harsh punishment but as an expression of love and care, aimed at guiding them away from destruction and shame.
